'''Grolodii Slatavv''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technician]].

Slatavv recommended capturing a [[Sector Plexus/Legends|Sector Plexus]] droid and using an [[A/E computer|Analysis/Encoding DocuServer]] to attempt to intercept Sector Plexus transmissions.
